args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and keep them until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts currently share the same `aria-live="polite"` region as info/success toasts, and every toast auto-dismisses after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5000ms) regardless of kind. Change the toast stack so error-kind toasts are rendered in (or announced via) an `aria-live="assertive"` region, and skip the auto-dismiss timer for error toasts so they stay until the user dismisses them with the close button.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The toast stack renders all toasts in one `role="status" aria-live="polite"` container and applies the same AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5s) timer to every item regardless of kind. Error toasts need an assertive live region and should not auto-dismiss, staying until the user closes them.
